requirements: R1: Implement missing OIDC support to complement existing OAuth2 and LTI authentication protocols

slices.title: Add OIDC protocol support for SSO authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing OIDC protocol support for this epic, I want to patch the existing authentication flow to add OIDC alongside OAuth2 and LTI, so that the SSO works across different standards is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a login request using OIDC,
When the system processes the request,
Then it should successfully authenticate the user and establish a session.
Given the newly added OIDC implementation,
When the CI pipeline runs,
Then the new protocol logic must be fully verified by integration tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Authentication success rate for OIDC requests
